recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key composition featuring a group of four men in 1970s fashion standing against a stark white background, topped by large, high-contrast serif typography that utilizes tight kerning and ligatures.
coreVisualRelationships: Stacked text centered in the upper third of the frame
Group of figures occupying the lower two-thirds
High-contrast black text against a pure white field
Shoulder-to-shoulder alignment of subjects creating a horizontal band
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no shadows or floor line
Tight, overlapping letterforms in the display text
Naturalistic, soft lighting on the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects centered horizontally, scaled to fill the bottom half of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold typography at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large text, moves down to the faces of the subjects, and then scans across the group horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the text and subjects, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted earth tones (Denim, grey vests, pink shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in clothing contrasted against high-value white background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to neutrals and soft pastels

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Tight tracking causing characters to touch or overlap
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all display elements to maintain minimalist impact.
graphicDevices: Negative space as a framing element

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs for tight stacking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men in 1970s rock fashion (shaggy hair, blazers, vests, denim) standing against a seamless, bright white studio background. The lighting should be soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, large, black uppercase serif text in the top third of the image. The letters should have high contrast and be spaced so tightly that they nearly touch.

verificationChecks: Are the letters touching or overlapping?
Is the text centered and dominant?
Does the fashion reflect the late 1970s?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the group
Specific color of the clothing accents
mustRedesign: The 'Compact Disc' logo in the corner
Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is solid black without gradients.
Check that the subjects are cut off at the waist or thighs.
Verify that the white space feels intentional and not empty.
Confirm the serif font has high stroke contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + Stacked high-contrast serif display type + Tight kerning = 1970s Editorial Aesthetic.
